theme.title: Broad Risk-Off
theme.summary: Technology (+0.04%) and Energy (-0.11%) led the market today, while Materials (-1.40%) and Utilities (-1.20%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.44%, defensives -0.72%, and value/cyclicals -0.55% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.18%, Dow -0.42%, Nasdaq -0.14% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -0.85%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX fell 1.49% to 15.21, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold slipped 0.07% to $4,393.60, crude oil was little changed at $97.25, and bitcoin gained 5.72% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
